operations.name: read_vga_enable
operations.desc: Read VGA enable status from device
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, dword [0xf0000000]
and eax, 0x00000001
ret

operations.name: read_framebuffer_base
operations.desc: Read framebuffer base address from device memory

operations.name: read_display_width
operations.desc: Read current display width in pixels
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, dword [0xf0000018]
and eax, 0x0000FFFF
ret

operations.name: read_display_height
operations.desc: Read current display height in pixels
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, dword [0xf000001C]
and eax, 0x0000FFFF
ret

operations.name: read_color_depth
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, dword [0xf0000020]
and eax, 0x000000FF
ret
